description.value: Mr. Sushi Lynn Valley is a family-owned Japanese sushi restaurant that has anchored the Lynn Valley neighbourhood since 1992, growing from a 500-square-foot space into a three-location North Vancouver institution. A North Shore News Readers' Choice Award winner, the restaurant is known for personalized service — staff pride themselves on remembering regulars' names and favourite orders. Touring cyclists rolling through Lynn Valley will find a full sit-down sushi experience as well as convenient online pickup ordering.
